subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the message tool expose only stable provider-name guidance now, or should its public schema also dynamically enumerate registered channel-plugin identifiers?
rationale: The description-only repair is narrow, while a dynamic enum creates a lasting model-facing plugin/schema contract whose source, alias handling, and availability semantics need maintainer intent.

options.title: Land description-only guidance
options.body: Clarify that `channel` selects a provider or channel plugin and that conversation, user, and channel IDs belong in the target field; defer enum exposure.

options.title: Adopt a dynamic enum contract
options.body: Derive schema values from the canonical registered channel-plugin identifiers and add focused coverage for aliases, ordering, and unavailable plugins.

options.title: Decline schema expansion
options.body: Retain prompt and fallback guidance only if maintainers do not want this model-facing schema contract expanded.

recommendation.title: Land description-only guidance
recommendation.body: Clarify that `channel` selects a provider or channel plugin and that conversation, user, and channel IDs belong in the target field; defer enum exposure.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied review already evaluated the message-tool, fallback, and plugin-registry tradeoff and is the strongest available routing signal.
